title: ExtraSMP
description: Plugin that makes it possible to find op loot in treasure chests
body:
Chest Loot Configuration

Configuration Features

Deathban Config

Configurable deathban duration (example: 30 minutes – 24 hours)

Optional permissions to bypass the deathban

Custom deathban messages

Naked Killing Config

Detects players attacking without armor

Configurable penalties or damage prevention

Toggle system (enable/disable in config)
